_readme: Where the key is, and where you learn to fight for it.
Row 5 is a wall with ONE gap, and a slink stands in it. That is the whole design: a
fight the quest requires is made unavoidable by GEOMETRY rather than by a trigger
radius. The player can see the gap, see what is standing in it, and there is no version
of slipping past - which is a fairer thing to lose to than a circle nobody drew.
The second slink is beside the stash. Two of them is exactly level 2, which is exactly
what the Keeper needs - see data/combat/quest_combat.tres for the arithmetic. Neither
can kill you: four damage a hit, at most four hits across both fights, against twenty
health. The hollow is where the timing is taught, and a tutorial that can kill you is
one people reload rather than read.
The stash is an object standing on a bush - there is no chest sprite and there does not
need to be one: an object is an interaction POINT, and what the player sees is the
decor tile that was already on the map. It carries once:true, so the memory of having
opened it lives in GameState.seen and survives a save.
